about_the_game:
This is a cozy adventure game where you play as Sophie, a young girl in 1970's France. Together with your pet rat Ami, who is also your best friend, you must escape an evil orphanage and embark on a journey to find your parents using puzzle-solving and stealth.

The Demo:

This demo version of What Comes Next is about 40 minutes long. You will experience two levels of dual perspective gameplay and cut-scenes, and be introduced to the story.

Solving Puzzles Together:

In order to progress through certain areas, some puzzles will require you to switch between the girl and the rat and use their different abilities.

Sneaking Past Enemies:

There are multiple enemies you’ll need to sneak past: guards, dogs, cats and the evil caretaker, Cruéll!

Play as Ami:

The rat is small and agile, allowing you to fit into small holes, jump over obstacles and find items for Sophie to use.

Story:

In What Comes Next, you play as Sophie, a young french girl in 1970's France. You live in an orphanage ran by an evil caretaker with your best friend, Ami, who also happens to be a rat. Together, you must escape the orphanage and embark on an adventure to find your parents.

In the game, you will play as both characters in order to solve puzzles, sneak past different enemies, and search a city for clues to your parents whereabouts.


What you can expect:

The game has stylized art, lovely music and sounds to go along with interesting areas to explore and an intriguing mystery ready to be uncovered. So get ready to go on this magical adventure together with your rat and together find out, What Comes Next.
